triggers.name: new_record
triggers.title: New record
triggers.help: Triggers when a new record is created in Quickbase. Trigger checks for new records every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes. Quickbase queries are supported to narrow down the list of records returned.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from

triggers.name: scheduled_table_query
triggers.title: Scheduled record search using query
triggers.description: Scheduled record search using query in Quickbase
triggers.help: Executes Quickbase query on specified schedule. Records meeting the query will be returned in lists of 1000 records per trigger event, by default.

input.name: app_name
input.label: Application
input.hint: Select an application in your Quickbase account.

input.name: apptoken
input.label: Application token
input.hint: Required if this application has been configured to require tokens for data access. Obtain token from the application's Settings > App properties > Manage Application Token . Learn more

input.name: table_id
input.label: Table
input.hint: Select a table in this application.

input.name: hour
input.label: Hour
input.hint: Hours in 24-hour format, i.e. 11 for 11am, 23 for 11pm. Defaults to 00 (12am) if left empty.

input.name: minute
input.label: Minute
input.hint: Minutes past the hour, i.e 00 for 0 minutes.

input.name: day_of_month
input.label: Day of month
input.hint: 1 - 31 , will be rounded down to last day of month for shorter months. Defaults to first day of the month if left empty.

input.name: query
input.label: Query
input.hint: Query syntax is {'fid'.operator.'matching_value'}. E.g. {'f_7'.EX.'Test'}. Learn more about queries here

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Minimum is 1, maximum is 1000. Default is 100.
